articles.headline: Ex-RBI Chief Urges Caution on Rupee Defence
articles.brief: Former Reserve Bank of India chief Raghuram Rajan has stated that India should not deplete its foreign exchange reserves to defend the weakening rupee against global market pressures, advocating for structural economic stability instead.

articles.headline: Indian Media Groups Challenge Privacy Law in Court
articles.brief: Major Indian media publishers, including outlets linked to industrial giants, are legally contesting the government's digital personal data law, warning that compliance mandates pose severe shutdown risks for newsrooms across the country.

articles.headline: Thousands Evacuate as Cyclone Arnab Nears Coast
articles.brief: Mass evacuations are underway along India's eastern coast as Cyclone Arnab rapidly intensifies, with authorities cancelling express trains, closing coastal areas, and putting disaster response teams on high alert ahead of landfall.

articles.headline: Indian Minister Denies US Pressure on Oil
articles.brief: India's oil minister has clarified that the United States has exerted no pressure on the nation to cut down its crude oil imports from Russia, despite ongoing global geopolitical shifts and sanctions.

articles.headline: India's Anaemia Programme Lacks Crucial Data
articles.brief: Public health experts have raised concerns that India's ambitious governmental programmes to combat widespread anaemia are currently operating without updated metrics, as crucial survey data remains unreleased to the public.

articles.headline: Instagram Tests 90-Minute Video Formats
articles.brief: Meta-owned Instagram is rolling out a new test feature allowing users to upload horizontal videos of up to 90 minutes, aiming to attract independent creators and challenge YouTube's dominance in long-form content.

articles.headline: Maharashtra Announces ₹7,500 Crore Drought Relief
articles.brief: Maharashtra Chief Minister Fadnavis has announced an advance drought relief package worth ₹7,500 crore, ensuring that nearly 1.5 million eligible farming households receive direct financial assistance to mitigate crop failure losses.

articles.headline: India Crushes New Zealand to Seal T20I Series
articles.brief: Riding on an explosive, record-breaking century from opener Abhishek Sharma, India secured a comfortable six-wicket victory over New Zealand, taking an unassailable 3-0 lead in the ongoing T20 international series.
